facts_raw.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + Technical / R&D
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Free accelerator; commercialization/customer access; C$345K+ perks. Separate investment program available.
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity for the accelerator program; free
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 来自加拿大，或明确希望进入加拿大市场的 ocean / maritime startup；目标是 first pilots 和 real-world deployments。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 已有 prototype/MVP；可在港口/航运/海洋环境进行真实测试；希望 Seed/Series A 融资。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 12周；以 British Columbia 为核心，包含加拿大 ecosystem/customer access。并非公开写明全程必须搬迁，但现场 pilot/partner engagement 很重要。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未公开统一 visa sponsorship；线下活动按加拿大入境要求。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: OceanTech / maritime / blue economy startup，尤其需要加拿大 pilot、港口、shipping、政府与商业化场景的团队。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 与 ocean/maritime 无关；还没有可测试产品；只想融资、不需要 pilot / market-entry 的团队。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：非常垂直，适合有真实 maritime hardware/software deployment 的团队；与普通 climate SaaS 匹配度低。

facts.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + Technical / R&D
facts.Funding / Support: Free accelerator; commercialization/customer access; C$345K+ perks. Separate investment program available.
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity for the accelerator program; free
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Canadian ocean or maritime startups, or those entering Canada, seeking initial pilots and real-world deployment.
facts.Strong-to-Have: A prototype or MVP suitable for port, shipping or ocean testing, with seed or Series A fundraising ambitions.
facts.On-site / Attendance: 12 weeks centered on British Columbia and Canadian customer access. Full relocation is not explicitly required, but on-site pilots and partner engagement are important.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa sponsorship published; Canadian entry requirements apply to in-person activities.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Ocean, maritime or blue-economy startups seeking Canadian pilots, ports, shipping partners and commercialization opportunities.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Teams unrelated to ocean or maritime sectors, without a testable product, or seeking funding without pilots or market entry.
facts.Notes: A specialist program for maritime hardware and software deployments; a weaker fit for general climate SaaS.
